title: Solidity Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Return a greeting
entries.summary: A contract groups functions and data. Call message() to read a greeting without changing stored data.
notes: Use the practice VM; no wallet or real money is needed.

entries.name: Return a whole number
entries.summary: uint256 stores a nonnegative whole number. Call answer() to add two small counts.
notes: Unsigned numbers cannot represent negative values.

entries.name: Read stored state
entries.summary: A state variable lives in contract storage. public creates a getter. Call score().
notes: Changing source code does not change a contract already deployed.

entries.name: Use a function input
entries.summary: A parameter is an input value. Call twice(4) in Remix.
notes: Very large products can overflow and revert in Solidity 0.8.

entries.name: Choose a message
entries.summary: if selects a result based on a rule. Call message(8).
notes: Specify memory for this returned string.

entries.name: Read an array item
entries.summary: A memory array is temporary data for the call. Call answer() to read its second item.
notes: An index outside the array reverts the call.

entries.name: Add values in a loop
entries.summary: A for loop repeats steps. Call answer() to add 1, 2 and 3.
notes: Unbounded loops can use too much gas in real transactions.

entries.name: Name a fixed choice
entries.summary: An enum names a small set of choices. Call answer() to read the chosen case number.
notes: Enum case numbers start at zero.

entries.name: Group fields
entries.summary: A struct groups related fields. Call answer() to read a book page count.
notes: Choose memory for a temporary struct used only inside a call.

entries.name: Read a mapping value
entries.summary: A mapping pairs keys with values. Unset integer keys return zero. Call scoreOf(1).
notes: A zero result does not tell you whether a key was ever written.

entries.name: Reject an invalid input
entries.summary: require stops a call when its rule is false. Call check(0) to see the error.
notes: A reverted call does not keep its state changes.

entries.name: Read state without changing it
entries.summary: view allows reading contract state. Call doubled() to read twice the stored score.
notes: pure cannot read state; use view when state is needed.
